adjudication.rationale: In spec/controllers/admin/groups_controller_spec.rb under context ".remove_member", the first test calls `xhr :put, :remove_member, group_id: 1, user_id: 42`, but config/routes.rb defines the route as `delete "members" => "groups#remove_member"`. Since controller specs invoke the action directly, this PUT request can still pass even though the real endpoint only accepts DELETE, meaning the spec doesn’t actually exercise the routed behavior.
